verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly state Mem0 Open Source is the same engine as the Platform, runs on your own infrastructure with full ownership of the stack and data, and ships as a Docker stack including REST API, dashboard, per-user API keys, and audit log — directly matching the self-hosting story. However, all evidence is first-party doc claims with no independent/hands-on verification of the Docker deployment actually working, and no detail on which components (vector DB, graph store) still require external services in self-hosted mode. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation of the Docker self-hosting process, and clarity on infrastructure dependencies for the open-source stack.
